# card_state: one token per card per zone, and a same-card attention bias (Evan's rows 65-66, part B)

Patch `card_state.patch` (on 77fbae0 + `card_latent.patch`; env/tokens.js, env/remote_worker.js, env/tools/probe_worker.js, rl/token_model.py, rl/gpu_matrix.py, rl/metagame.py, rl/remote.py, rl/train.py; about 190 lines), design in `reports/Unified card token references.md` (B). Both keys default 0; off is bit-identical.
- `state_canon` 1 (needs `"canon": 1` in the worker command; the config records it only when on). In env/tokens.js, with `canon`, an open prompt's listed cards push no PROMPT tokens: each sets a listed flag on its zone token, found by object identity (hand: HAND, my discard: MY_DISCARD, my deck or prizes: MY_UNSEEN, opponent's discard: OPP_DISCARD). Picked cards set a picked flag on the token they were listed on (else their HAND / discard / unseen token). The seat's own resolving Trainer (X1's test: game.chain.key starts 'trainer|', prompt open, seat is the active player) sets a source flag on its HAND token, else MY_DISCARD, else a PROMPT-kind token with aux 128 (also when the card sits in the Supporter zone).
- aux bits on zone kinds only (HAND .. OPP_DECKLIST, PROMPT, PICKED; a board token's aux is a slot, ENERGY's up to 95): copies in bits 0-4 (clamped to 31; the 24 lists have at most 19 copies of a card, and no zone token reached 19), 32 listed, 64 picked, 128 source. In the model, the aux embedding reads `aux & 31` on those kinds; the three flags are `flag_emb` (3 x d, small random) times `g_flag` (3 zero-init scalars, ReZero), added to the token. Not an identity start (token set and aux change); fine-tune from C49-sd.
- With `cand_latent_zone` also on, a pick-from-prompt candidate gathers the tokens flagged listed (any zone) or PROMPT-kind leftovers; if none, all matches as before. Left out: cards listed from a Pokemon's attached Energy (about 7% of listed cards in "Choose cards" prompts) and Choose-energy / move-Energy picks keep PROMPT tokens or resolve to ENERGY tokens (no free aux bit there).
- `state_key` 1 (model only): `key_bias` [layers, heads], zero-init, times a 0/1 matrix (same nonzero card id, different kind) added to each encoder layer's attention bias (summed with slot_bind's). 65% of tokens have such a partner. Identity start.
- Wiring: gpu_matrix `canon_of(models)`, metagame and train.py collect messages send `"canon"` from the model config; remote.py `_canon_guard` (run first in `collect`) refuses a token command whose `canon` does not match its models, and a round that mixes canon and non-canon models (workers encode one way). Loaders (gpu_matrix.load_policy, train NEW_WEIGHTS / token_net / --init-from) accept `flag_emb`, `g_flag`, `key_bias`. warmstart.py and other command builders were not touched: they would be refused for a canon model.
- ar/train.py (not in git): add `"canon": int(MODEL_OVERRIDES.get("state_canon", 0))` to its collect message (like `"chain"`, which it also lacks). ar/fixed.py: M goes through GpuMatrix.attach -> `play`, which sends canon from the model config, so it is covered. The guard S plays the trained pilot against the start pilot in one `play(models={0: model, 1: start})`; with canon that mixes encodings and the new guard raises. S needs a decision (not built): per-model encoding in the worker, or loading `start` with the same override (a degraded, non-identity opponent), or dropping S for canon runs. Any patch to rl/ or env/ also means a new `--setup` and `--calibrate`.

MODEL_OVERRIDES (ar/train.py):
    {"state_canon": 1, "cand_latent": 1, "cand_latent_zone": 1, "cand_latent_gate": 1}   # strongest: B with A
    {"state_key": 1}                                                                    # variant, identity start

Tests (CPU; paths in each header). `test_card_state.js` (node, 60 random-play games of the 24 lists, 11,255 decisions, 5,011 prompts): canon 0 equals a clean tree on every field; canon 1 flags every listed card, leaves PROMPT tokens only for cards with no zone token, no PICKED token left, a source flag on every resolving-Trainer prompt, non-zone tokens unchanged, tokens 86.2 -> 84.7 per decision, never more than plain + the source token; per-prompt-type table printed. `test_card_state.py` (43 checks, 1,111 C49-sd decisions plus 1,927 canon-token decisions it collects): (a) off identical to card_latent (chain 0 / 4, cand_latent on / off); (b) key_bias 0 identical, 1 changes outputs, gradient on key_bias; (c) flags in real worker output, gates 0 ignore flags, g_flag gets gradient; (d) pick-from-prompt candidates: pick_card 95.8% reach a flagged or PROMPT token (flag alone 79.5%, 762 candidates), all reach some token, but over all verbs 11-15 the flag alone is 47.0% because 528 of 1,290 are move-Energy picks that read ENERGY tokens; (e) C49-sd loads with each override, fresh params only the new ones, state_key step 0 identical; (f) the guard. Not run: GPU, ONNX export, any training or play strength, X1.
